issues.description: Default turn_detection_mode flip from EXTERNAL to FIXED silently changes runtime behavior for existing callers.
issues.detail: All three reviewers flagged this as a contract change disguised as a fix. Existing users instantiating InputParams() will silently switch endpointing modes, altering who owns turn boundaries, VAD emission, and finalization. The changelog filename and docstrings understate the migration. Document the shift in a .changed.md, add a transitional warning, or gate behind an explicit opt-in.

issues.description: process_frame only finalizes on VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame, narrowing the accepted frame contract.
issues.detail: The handler now ignores UserStoppedSpeakingFrame and conditionally warns vs. finalizes on VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame based on hidden mode state. Callers wiring non-VAD producers silently lose finalization. Either accept both frame types, subscribe to the frame only when not _enable_vad, or document the stricter precondition at the supertype boundary.

issues.description: _enable_vad complects multiple concerns across two enums without a stated invariant.
issues.detail: One boolean derived from EndOfUtteranceMode now governs frame emission, external-finalize acceptance, and a warning branch, while the new TurnDetectionMode.FIXED default implicitly maps onto it. The invariant lives only in a list literal (which should be a tuple/frozenset anyway). Express it as named predicates derived from the mode and write the contract down at the class boundary.

issues.description: split_sentences plumbed as Optional[bool] then coerced with `or False`, unconditionally overwriting vendor defaults.
issues.detail: The tri-state None/True/False adds no value; declare `bool = False` and drop the coercion. Worse, speech_segment_config is always replaced, clobbering whatever SDK default existed. If None means 'don't touch,' honor that; otherwise pick a concrete default and stop coercing at the write site.

issues.description: Commented-out start_processing_metrics line was relocated rather than deleted or restored.
issues.detail: The diff moves `# await self.start_processing_metrics()` from after the broadcast to before it. Commented code encodes an unresolved decision in source. Either uncomment it and own the ordering, or delete it — git remembers if needed later.

issues.description: split_sentences threaded through a stringly-typed allowlist where the config mapping should be data.
issues.detail: Adding a parameter requires editing a hard-coded name list and trusting hasattr to silently drop typos. Express the config mapping as data (a dict, or a list derived from the InputParams schema) so adding a field happens in one place and typos surface loudly.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on a small but contract-shifting patch. The headline concern (all three reviewers) is the silent default flip from EXTERNAL to FIXED, which changes who owns turn boundaries for every existing caller without a migration path or proper changelog labeling. The second consensus issue is that process_frame now narrows its accepted frame contract to VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame with a hidden-mode-dependent warn-vs-finalize branch. The third is that _enable_vad complects multiple concerns across two enums with the invariant living only in a list literal. Smaller cleanups: collapse the Optional[bool] split_sentences dance, stop unconditionally overwriting speech_segment_config, resolve the relocated commented metrics line, and turn the stringly-typed config allowlist into data.
